mentions.name: Presbot
mentions.description: This is a website assistant for businesses and website owners that answers visitor questions and then gets out of the way. When it cannot answer or the visitor wants to speak with a human, it collects a short predefined inquiry instead. It was originally built before ChatGPT existed and has since been rebuilt while keeping the original idea intact.
mentions.problem: Visitors usually have a question they want answered, not necessarily a desire to "chat".
mentions.source_excerpt:
Presbot: https://presbot.com

It’s a small assistant for businesses and website owners. The idea is pretty simple. Visitors usually have a question they want answered, not necessarily a desire to "chat"

It answers what it can and when it can’t or when someone wants to speak with a human it collects a short predefined inquiry instead
mentions.author: tumidpandora
